descriptionMarkdown:
- Rushable giga ship that work from early to mid to endgame in the same blueprint.
- Can get both sub 40 hours, Rush to Space and Express Delivery steam achievements in the same save run.
- No quality mess.
- I did it with just one ship + 1k spm nauvis base (huge mall) + 100 spm bases per planet, but some small fast haulers could help. 
- Work on red belts + solar panels till Aquilo. 
- Only need Nuclear, Foundries and blue belts for space edge. 
- You can set it on automatic, and control it by the green wire in the big electric pole. 
- Turn yellow inserters to star the reactor, just manual feed it once!
title: Express Delivery Ship
